title: Album Cover with Four Men and Text
coreRelationships: The four men are arranged horizontally, forming a cohesive group portrait.
The bold pink typography of the album title contrasts sharply with the white background and the darker tones of the men's clothing.
The tracklist text is significantly smaller and more detailed, providing a secondary layer of information.
The overall composition balances a strong photographic element with prominent typographic branding.

Replace the subtitle and tracklist with new dark red/brown uppercase sans-serif text, maintaining their relative scale and position. Ensure the small top-left logo is present.
